title: Mobile access
lead: Follow the agents from the phone: what waits for a decision, allow or refuse, send a prompt, read the end of the output of an agent. Only through Tailscale, never on the Internet, and with pairing.
pairStep1Before: On the iPhone or the iPad, open
pairStep1After: and make sure that it is connected.
pairStep2: Scan this QR code with the camera, then open the link in Safari.
pairStep3After: : Heidrun then opens like an app.
qrSecret: The QR code contains the pairing key: do not show it, do not share it.
revokeTitle: The devices already paired will have to scan the QR code again
setupStep1After: on this Mac and on the iPhone / the iPad (App Store), connect them with the same account (Google, Apple…).
setupStep2: Turn it on here: macOS can ask to allow incoming connections for Heidrun, answer Allow.
